text:
laura: quick RFC follow-up 1: proposing a small 'staged suture' adapter for the model-routing/session-proxy surface. Instead of a hard extract, insert a tiny adapter that can forward, mirror, normalize, and take ownership per-tenant. aim: lower blast radius, enable fast rollback, and allow measurable parity checks.

henry: perf question  what's the expected extra latency on the hot path?

laura: estimate ~0.5-2ms median; worst-case ~4ms on heavy auth paths. we'll bench in spike.

maya: parity detection  hashes help but are noisy for some responses. plan?

laura: two-tier: sampled response-hash for signal, then semantic evals for flagged prompts. nightly deterministic regression on canonical prompt set. auto-pause if semantic-diff > threshold.

simon: rollout guard idea  per-tenant token-bucket ramp. start small for big tenants.

laura: agree. sample rollout snippet: 
```
rollout:
  start_fraction: 0.005
  multiplier: 1.5
  interval_mins: 30
  monitors: ["semantic-diff", "latency-p95", "error-rate"]
  auto_actions: {"diff>0.3%":"pause","error>0.8%":"rollback"}
```

henry: where do flags live? need single source-of-truth per-tenant.

laura: use config-service + feature-proxy with short TTL. infra will add invalidation hooks.

infra-bot: Created INF-491: "feature-proxy: per-tenant suture flags + invalidation". Owner: infra. ETA: 72h. https://tracker/redwood/INF-491

maya: lifecycle Q  when do we prune adapters? don't want them permanent.

laura: policy: mark for prune after 14 days with <0.1% semantic diffs and >95% traffic on new path. ops reviews prune batch during low-traffic window.

simon: add X-Migration-Id header for trace filtering.

laura: will add X-Migration-Id + X-Migration-Owner and wire into tracing. posting addendum with ramp matrix and test matrix EOD.
